__EYEBROW__: 3D · Z up · DJI RMUC2026 V2.0.0 · Creo export · meshed from the split part files
__SUB__: Every part file re-read and tessellated by OCCT on this laptop, placed by the STEP assembly transforms.
__ABOUT__: Not the 204 MB whole-file glb. This mesh was produced from the per-product part files the split wrote: each was opened by OCCT on its own (milliseconds for arena bodies, up to 2.5 minutes for the 674 MB equipment product), tessellated at 4 mm / 0.5 rad for arena parts and coarser for the large equipment products, and placed with the transforms read from the STEP assembly entities. In this Creo export every arena face, body and edge style resolves to one shared cream colour entity, so the arena is tinted by height above the floor slab by default; equipment keeps the 30 colours it carries in the file.
